fields.name: KEEP IT GOOD
fields.value: Chirp the team, not the person. Keep it fun and respectful, and remember everyone here is a co-owner of the league.

fields.name: NOT HERE
fields.value: Rule disputes, trade negotiations or anything that needs a ruling. Take those to the Commissioner's Office.
